description: AI models often pay more attention to the beginning and end of a conversation while neglecting information in the middle, a phenomenon called 'loss-in-middle-turns'.

instances.assertion: AI models often pay more attention to the beginning and end of a conversation while neglecting information in the middle, a phenomenon called 'loss-in-middle-turns'.
AI models exhibit 'loss-in-middle-turns' where they neglect information provided in the middle of long conversations.
